newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open little changed.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open mostly flat Wednesday, based on market orders at 1017 EST, floor sources said.
Support was pegged at 74.30 cents a lb for March delivery. Resistance was seen at 75.50, where producer selling is likely to cap gains.
Tuesday, NYCE cotton closed lower, with March down 0.49 at 74.51 after trading from 74.95 to 74.50 cents.
Volume was estimated to have reached only 3,500 lots.
